name: Pec Deck (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with a slight bend in your elbows.
Bring your arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the centre.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A machine fly that isolates the chest by bringing the arms together in front of you.
